title: Diagnosis summary reads only the historical Campaign evidence-policy location
observation: The sealed RMSNorm Run has archive integrity and custody, but the pinned --compiler-gaps tool refuses with diagnosis summary requires retained Executor and evidence policy. Its authority is a RunSpecification with top-level evidence_policy; the script reads only resolved_inputs.evidence_policy from historical Campaign authorities. The failure prevents curation without proving any Compiler gap.
proposed_change: Read the RunSpecification-owned policy for its declared schema and matching Run id; retain historical Campaign handling, exact retained Executor grouping, integrity gates and no semantic reclassification. Never substitute a Campaign policy for a malformed Run authority or change frozen evidence.
promotion_disposition: Shared diagnosis tooling repair proposed. No IR, lowering, Verifier, timing or optimization promotion.
